'''''Kashyyyk at Night''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was part of a series of five paintings, alongside ''[[Gift Giving Wookiees]]'', ''[[Proud Wookiee]]'', ''[[Red Robed Wookiee]]'', and ''[[Wookiee with Pups]]'', that were made for the festivities of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. The painting in question depicted a Wookiee tree settlement on Kashyyyk during the nighttime. It was supplied during the events of an annual Life Day celebration on Kashyyyk.

==Behind the scenes==
''Kashyyyk at Night'', alongside ''[[Gift Giving Wookiees]]'', ''[[Proud Wookiee]]'', ''[[Red Robed Wookiee]]'' and ''[[Wookiee with Pups]]'', were supplied during the 2006 Wookiee Life Day festivities.
